question: Who among the following was elected as the first President of Hockey India from north-east India in November 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gyanendro Ningombam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• On being elected unopposed, **Ningobam becomes the first President from the North East region to spearhead Hockey India.**
 
• He formerly held the position of officiating President after Mohd Mushtaque Ahmed had tendered his resignation in July this year.
 
• On 6 November 2020, Manipur's Gyanendra Ningombam was elected unopposed as the President
